pages.text: Forge the Qi Pouch in a Ding with its forging jade slip: Patterned Cloth ×2, Spirit-Guiding Thread ×2, Zhenwen Jade ×1, Kongming Stone ×1, Spirit Storage Crystal ×1, and Spiritwood Clasp ×1.$(br2)Purity sets the square floor from 2×2 up to 30×30. Every pouch has a real grass floor with exactly five buildable air blocks above it. Opening costs 10 Qi.

The pouch GUI shows the entire real block volume at once. Left-drag rotates, right-drag pans, and the wheel zooms. Drag blocks or flying weapons onto visible surfaces; blocks stack naturally up to the five-block ceiling. Single-click a utility block to open its real menu and double-click to recover it. Ordinary items belong inside placed storage blocks. Flying weapons support automatic recall; inspect Sword Flight and Recall for the current controls.$(br2)Mystic Bronze Mirror: right-click to spend 50 Qi and scan nearby hidden formations, ambient Qi, and spirit-vein centers for 3 seconds.
$(br)Small Level Up and Big Level Up items add cultivation progress when right-clicked.$(br2)The Debug Stat Editor opens a test GUI for changing player stats during development.
$(br)Magic Ritual Spirit Stones restore Qi when used: low grade restores 10, middle grade restores 100, and high grade restores 1,000. Infinite Spirit Stones restore 10,000 Qi and are never consumed.
